rounds.oldMeaning: Ukuqeda noma ukushabalalisa into. Kwakushiwo nangomlilo, izifo noma impi.
rounds.story: Ukudla kwake kwakubanzi: umlilo noma impi nakho 'kudla'. Kancane kancane igama lagxila kakhulu esidlweni sabantu.
Umfundisi livela kokuthi ukufundisa. Ngesikhathi sezithunywa zenkolo lagxila kakhulu kumholi wesonto.

rounds.oldMeaning: Iqembu labantu elibiziwe, umhlangano noma umkhandlu.
rounds.story: Ibandla lalisuke lingumhlangano nje. Ezinguqulweni zeBhayibheli nasenkolweni laba yigama elivamile lesonto.

rounds.oldMeaning: Ukukhonza inkosi noma induna, okungukuthi ukuyisebenzela nokuyilandela.
rounds.story: Ukukhonza kwaqala kakhulu ngokuthembeka enkosini. Kamuva kwasetshenziswa kakhulu ekukhulekeni nasekumdumisaneni noNkulunkulu.

rounds.oldMeaning: Umbusi, induna enkulu noma umholi wesizwe.
rounds.story: Inkosi kwakuyisikhulu somhlaba. Ekukhulumeni kwenkolo iNkosi laba igama elivamile likaNkulunkulu noma likaJesu.

rounds.oldMeaning: Umoya ophefumulwayo noma ovunguzayo. Kwakubhekwa kakhulu ekuphefumuleni nasemoyeni wemvelo.
rounds.story: Umoya waqala njengokuphefumula noma umoya wemvelo. Kamuva wandisa nencazelo yokuthi umoya noma isimo sangaphakathi.

rounds.oldMeaning: Intombi esanda kuganwa, ikakhulukazi ngesikhathi somshado noma ngokushesha emva kwawo.
rounds.story: Umakoti ekuqaleni wayeyintombi esanda kuganwa. Emizini eminingi igama laqhubeka lasebenza kakhulu kumalokazana.
Inkosikazi yaqala ngokubhekisa kowesifazane wenkosi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi yanda yasho unkosikazi noma owesifazane omdala ngenhlonipho.

rounds.oldMeaning: Noma yiluphi uhlobo lomsebenzi noma inkonzo eyenziwayo.
rounds.story: Umsebenzi wake wabhekisa kunoma yiluphi uhlobo lomsebenzi. Namuhla abaningi baqala bacabange ngomsebenzi wokuqashwa.
Umzalwane ekuqaleni wayengowasekhaya noma wesihlobo. Emasontweni waba yigama elivamile lomuntu okholwa kanye nawe.
Usindiso lwaqala njengokusinda engozini yangempela. Ekusetshenzisweni kwenkolo lwagxila kakhulu ensindisweni yomoya.

rounds.oldMeaning: Ububele, isipho noma ukwenzela omunye okuhle.
rounds.story: Umusa wawungaba ububele noma isipho. Ezinkulumweni zenkolo usho kakhulu isihe nomusa kaNkulunkulu.
